newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Olsen elected new premier of South Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Olsen elected new premier of South Australia.

text.p: Dean Brown was replaced by key rival John Olsen as the premier of South Australia on Wednesday in a vote by members of the ruling Liberal Party government.
Olsen, the industry minister and a former senator in the national parliament, told reporters he was elected unopposed.
Brown became premier in December 1993 in an election that was based on the scandle surrounding the collapse of the State Bank of SA during the Labor Party's time in office.
Brown was under pressure in recent months due to poor opinion polls and concern about the state's economy.
